scope: Installed ESP32-S3 address-domain and reservation accounting; read-only source/ELF/API-record audit, no new execution or worst-case peak claim

installed.core_host_now: e525060; not the installed image source

method.elf: Hash-verified live ELF read in memory as ELF32 little-endian; allocated section headers, public symbols and compiled soc_memory_regions/types/reserved descriptors decoded without writing or exposing binary/configuration bytes
method.map: Exact retained matching map SHA256 checked independently; no external-RAM/dummy flash section interpreted as physical allocation
method.sdk: Configured memory-layout source defines aliases, capabilities, static exclusions and the additional runtime ROM-table reservation. heap_caps_get_total_size sums raw registered region spans, including in-region allocator metadata.
method.rom: The ROM table itself was not read. Its exclusion extent is inferred from the sole runtime reservation in the SDK algorithm and the observed full 8-bit registered span; it is not labelled an independently sampled ROM pointer.

disjoint_domains.name: shared D/IRAM static reservation including padding
registered 8-bit SDK heap spans, main SRAM plus RTC-fast
disjoint_domains.note: Already includes all dynamic task stacks/TCBs, transport/runtime/USB/security allocations and allocator control blocks; do not add these owners again.

disjoint_domains.name: derived ROM runtime exclusion
disjoint_domains.status: Inferred under the exact SDK heap-registry contract, not a direct ROM-table read.

equations: 100551 static summary content + 17 IRAM tail-alignment bytes = 100568 shared physical reservation
425984 shared D/IRAM + 32768 DRAM-only + 8168 RTC-fast available - 100568 static - 4556 ROM = 361796 registered heap-span bytes

inferred_registered_heaps.note: SDK enables the reclaimed non-OS stack heap immediately before app_main; this final span is not an additional stack allocation.

isr_stack.interpretation: Two configured 1536-byte ISR stack reservations already included in static data; use/high-water not instrumented.

worker_stack.interpretation: Existing heap allocation; measured touched-stack watermark is not a verified maximum SP depth.

key_reservations.nesting: Managed owner is inside the future/worker stack; entropy owner in its outer worker frame; component inline storage is inside static BSS; TLS occupies existing task stacks. None is additive to the physical partition or SDK heap.

coverage.no_omitted_standard_32bit_or_exec_heap: Compiled regions use types RAM, DRAM and RTCRAM only. Each has INTERNAL and 8BIT capabilities; the IRAM type has no registered region with MEMPROT enabled. All-8bit therefore covers all standard registered heaps for this image. PSRAM is disabled.
coverage.heap_sample: 21 selected complete task snapshots; internal/all 8-bit totals both 361796; capability views overlap and are sequential.
coverage.startup_history: Per-region minimum-free and the worker lifetime stack watermark retain exercised post-registration startup history even when API subscription misses the startup log. They do not attribute a minimum to a phase, observe pre-registration ROM execution, or establish a simultaneous global peak.
coverage.remaining_peak_limits: Dynamic per-owner attribution, full compiler/callee/interrupt SP depth, pre-observation boot task use, terminal worker use and worst-case initialization/rekey peaks remain unmeasured. Known reservations are covered; the ledger is physical capacity accounting rather than a measured minimum deployment requirement.

finite_capture_contract.trigger: Only the already approved parent-owned admin/session-reset work; no additional benchmark loop, forced power loss, key creation or instrumentation.
finite_capture_contract.before: API connected and one complete selected-run resource/task/network snapshot before the reset.
finite_capture_contract.after: One authenticated fresh EDHOC/OSCORE operation plus one complete selected-run post-operation snapshot; two post-operation periodic snapshots if they occur within the same finite capture.
acceptance: Capture complete, overflow false, exact installed run_id, complete task snapshots with declared count equal to unique numeric IDs; preserve raw capture hash and host/serial UTC markers.

During each confirmed boot compare constant total capacity, lifetime region minima, largest free block, worker reserved/touched high-water and per-task free margins. Do not combine task IDs or minima across a confirmed esp_restart.

API reconnect alone is not a boot marker. COAPTIC_PAIRING_EVENT 3/4 are application-success events, not session-generation counters. Host session-generation/authenticated-response logs and actual admin/reset acknowledgments establish the exercised transition.

The missing before_platform_setup/COAPTIC_ENTROPY row cannot be reconstructed. Pairing mode starts before the network API is necessarily available; live API capture is not guaranteed to obtain early boot logs.
Report selected transition as observed with lifetime envelopes and reservation headroom; do not upgrade to worst-case startup/rekey/ISR peak qualification.

limits: Physical addresses with IRAM/DRAM aliases are counted once; .dram0.dummy reserves the code alias and is not an extra physical block.
Flash mapped/no-load/dummy sections are address-space placement, not PSRAM or additional runtime RAM; debug ELF file bytes are not runtime RAM.

Registered heap spans include their allocator control areas. Allocated payload, nonfree, overlapping capabilities, per-region minima, task stacks, nested App/future/scratch and static domains must not be added as separate owners.
Derived ROM exclusion closes the capacity equation under the existing SDK region registry; no direct read of ets_rom_layout_p at runtime was performed.
No new device action, build, COM6 access, repository edit, key/configuration write or external publication was performed by this audit.
